name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 57 - Am 56
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 57a. Stresses the need to support, including at EU level, an evidence-based housing first approach, whereby homeless people are provided with unconditional, decentralised and permanent housing in self-contained flats, before receiving other forms of social support measures, together with equal access to support measures, public health and social benefits, as well as measures to reduce discrimination against homeless people of foreign nationality; stresses that this framework should include binding targets, specific EU funding under the ESF+ and specific provisions to prevent homelessness, particularly among children, young people and migrants;
